div.head: IV Eg 6.1
div.ab: ⁊ heora ælc, þonne hine man ærest to wytnesse gecysð, sylle þone að, þæt he næfre, ne for feo ne for lufe ne for ege, ne ætsace nanes þara þinga þe he to gewytnesse wæs, ⁊ nan oðer þingc on gewytnesse ne cyðe butan þæt án þæt he geseah oððe gehyrde.

And each of them, when he is first chosen as a witness, shall swear an oath that he will never, for money, or favour or fear, deny any of the things of which he has witness, or declares in his testimony anything except only what he has seen and heard.

⁊ heora ælc, þonne hine man ærest to witnysse gecysð, sylle þæne að, þæt he næfre, ne for feo ne for lufe ne for ege, ne ætsace nanes þara þinga, þe he to gewitnysse wæs, ⁊ nán oðer þingc on gewytnesse ne cyðe buton þæt án, þæt he geseah oððe gehyrde.
